product_one_liner.value: WindBorne sells atmospheric observations from its long-duration balloon constellation and AI-generated global weather forecasts to government agencies and commercial users.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage says WindBorne combines long-duration balloon observations with AI models to produce forecasts and actionable insights. Its announcement identifies a government customer and expansion into commercial users.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage routes visitors to product and solution pages or to contact the team, and does not provide a public pricing link or published prices.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The announcement calls NOAA an operational customer and identifies contracts or awards with the U.S. Air Force and Navy. | named_customers.0: The cited company announcement explicitly calls NOAA an operational customer. | named_customers.1: The announcement identifies Air Force contracts and awards, supporting it as a government customer. | named_customers.2: The announcement identifies Navy contracts and awards, supporting it as a government customer.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 103 employees, which falls in the 101–200 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile locates WindBorne in Redwood City, California, and its career listing gives a Redwood City address. Some company copy calls the location Redwood Shores, so Redwood City is used as the city-level headquarters location. | hq_country: The company profile identifies the country as the United States and the locality as Redwood City, California.

founded_year.notes: WindBorne’s own press announcement says the company originated as a Stanford project and was founded in 2019; the earlier date refers to the project origin.

eng_blog.notes: The company blog includes at least two technical posts—on AI data assimilation and WeatherMesh architecture—each authored by a Machine Learning Engineer.

public_docs.notes: WindBorne provides public API documentation with model, observation, getting-started, and API reference materials.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current openings page lists seven jobs, none with an AI/ML or data-science title; the listed Sensor Data Engineer role does not meet the specified title criteria.

model_provider.value: WindBorne’s proprietary WeatherMesh AI models and AI data-assimilation system; MetaMesh also blends public AI and numerical weather prediction models, but no third-party model provider is named.
model_provider.notes: WindBorne’s documentation identifies WeatherMesh as its family of AI models and describes its data-assimilation system as proprietary. MetaMesh combines those models with public AI/NWP forecasts, without naming a third-party model vendor.

compliance_certs.notes: The company has a legal/privacy page with a Security section, but it describes general safeguards and names none of the listed certifications.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding announcement explicitly identifies the latest round as Series B. | funding_date: The funding announcement was published August 5, 2026 and identifies the latest round as Series B; the requested year-month is 2026-08. | funding_amount_usd: The funding announcement states that WindBorne raised $37 million in a Series B round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest round was announced in August 2026, less than 18 months before November 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current openings page lists seven roles, none titled SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: The company blog index announces that WindBorne Weather Events became available through its API on October 29, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The current, small leadership roster lists founders and a meteorology director. The profile’s Head of Product start date is September 2025, before the 12-month window ending November 2026; no C-level/VP departure announcement was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable sales role refers generically to using a CRM but does not name a vendor; the current openings page and product documentation do not identify a CRM or sales/marketing system in use.
